tickets.subject: Feature request: bulk edit product prices
tickets.body: It would save us hours every season if we could edit prices on many products at once instead of one by one.

tickets.subject: How do I add a teammate?
tickets.body: New hire starting Monday. How do I add a teammate to our account and set their permissions?

tickets.subject: Typo on the pricing page
tickets.body: Small thing, but 'billed anually' on your pricing page should be 'annually'.

tickets.subject: Request: dark mode for the admin
tickets.body: Any chance of a dark mode for the admin panel? Our ops team works late shifts and the white background is rough.

tickets.subject: App keeps signing me out
tickets.body: The mobile app keeps signing me out every few hours. Started this week — it used to stay signed in.

tickets.subject: GDPR: data processing agreement request
tickets.body: Our legal team needs a copy of your standard data processing agreement for our GDPR records.

tickets.subject: Logged out of the app every few hours
tickets.body: I get logged out of the iPhone app every few hours and have to sign back in. Annoying when I'm checking orders on the go.

tickets.subject: Reset link never comes
tickets.body: I requested a password reset twice this morning and the email never arrives. Checked spam, nothing there.

tickets.subject: Export shows weird characters
tickets.body: The customer CSV export shows weird characters — names like Renée come out as RenÃ©e. The data looks fine on screen.

tickets.subject: Need a copy of our March invoice
tickets.body: Could you resend our March invoice? Accounting misplaced it and we're closing the quarter.

tickets.subject: Team keeps losing sessions on mobile
tickets.body: Our whole team keeps losing their sessions on the mobile app and getting bounced to the sign-in screen. Web is fine.

tickets.subject: Locked out of my account
tickets.body: Locked out since yesterday — the reset email never shows up no matter how many times I request it.

tickets.subject: Sales report times out
tickets.body: The monthly sales report page times out after about a minute of loading. It worked fine last week.

tickets.subject: Umlauts broken in CSV
tickets.body: German umlauts are broken in the CSV export — Müller becomes MÃ¼ller. This was fine in July.

tickets.subject: iOS app logout loop
tickets.body: The iOS app is in a logout loop for our warehouse staff: sign in, works for a bit, kicked out again.

tickets.subject: Dashboard just spins
tickets.body: The analytics dashboard just spins and never renders. Tried two browsers and an incognito window.

tickets.subject: Staff can't reset passwords
tickets.body: Three of our staff can't reset their passwords. No emails arriving, not in spam either. They're blocked from working.

tickets.subject: Japanese names corrupted in export file
tickets.body: Japanese customer names are corrupted in the export file. They display fine on screen but the downloaded file is garbage characters.

tickets.subject: One product image failed to upload
tickets.body: One product image failed to upload yesterday with a generic error. Worked on retry — just flagging in case it matters.

tickets.subject: No email on password reset
tickets.body: Password reset emails aren't coming through to our @brightline.travel addresses. Two agents affected so far.

tickets.subject: Month-to-date view won't load
tickets.body: The month-to-date view won't load at all today. Yesterday it eventually loaded after several minutes.

tickets.subject: Customer list download unreadable
tickets.body: The customer list download opens as gibberish for any name with accents. Excel shows squares and question marks.

tickets.subject: Checkout errors for our shoppers
tickets.body: Since about 2:15 this afternoon shoppers who hit Place Order are getting an error page. One of them sent a screenshot of a $2,300 cart. Nothing changed on our side.

tickets.subject: Payment failures on large orders
tickets.body: We had three failed payments this afternoon: €1,250, €1,900 and €4,100. A €40 test order went through fine. This started today.

tickets.subject: Webhook docs page 404s
tickets.body: Your webhook documentation page returns a 404. The link from the developer portal is dead.

tickets.subject: Card declines?
tickets.body: Customers say their cards get declined at checkout but their banks show no charge attempt at all. Happened on a $1,600 order and a $2,050 order yesterday evening.

tickets.subject: Forgot password broken
tickets.body: The forgot password flow says 'email sent' but nothing ever arrives. Tried three times.

tickets.subject: HTTP 500 from your API
tickets.body: Our monitoring shows POST /v2/transactions returning 500s since Tuesday afternoon. Only requests above four figures seem affected. Trace attached.

tickets.subject: Session expires constantly
tickets.body: My session expires constantly on the Android app. Really disruptive during stocktake — I lose my place every time.

tickets.subject: Urgent: enterprise checkout down
tickets.body: Our B2B portal can't process quarterly restocks since yesterday. These are five-figure carts. Reproduced on Chrome and Edge. This is blocking revenue — please treat as P1.

tickets.subject: Still locked out — second request
tickets.body: Second request — still locked out, still no reset email. This is getting urgent, I can't get into my own store.

tickets.subject: Can we get SMS notifications?
tickets.body: Would love SMS notifications for new orders so I don't have to keep the app open.

tickets.subject: Booking payments failing
tickets.body: High-season bookings over €1,000 are failing at the pay step. Mostly Safari on iPhone but we saw one on Firefox too. Smaller bookings go through.

tickets.subject: Any update on my login issue?
tickets.body: Following up on my reset problem from Sunday. Any update? I still can't get in.

tickets.subject: Something broke at the last step
tickets.body: A shopper told us she filled everything in, hit the button, and got a white screen. Nothing loaded after that. She gave up and went to a competitor.

tickets.subject: Analytics page returns 504
tickets.body: The analytics page returns a 504 gateway timeout for us since Wednesday. Every region of our team sees the same.

tickets.subject: CSV still mangled after re-export
tickets.body: The CSV is still mangled after re-exporting like support suggested last time. Same broken characters.

tickets.subject: Checkout failing for bulk electronics orders
tickets.body: Distributor orders above ¥150,000 error out at checkout. The browser console shows the request to /v2/transactions timing out after 30 seconds. Smaller consumer orders are unaffected.

tickets.subject: Have to log in ten times a day
tickets.body: I have to log in ten times a day on my phone now. It used to keep me signed in for weeks. What changed?

tickets.subject: Reports unusable this week
tickets.body: Reports have been unusable all week — either timeouts or half-rendered charts. We fly blind on inventory without them.

tickets.subject: Can't buy seats
tickets.body: Schools purchasing 40+ seat licenses get stuck on the final page and nothing happens. A 5-seat purchase worked fine when we tested it ourselves.

tickets.subject: Order search: add date filters?
tickets.body: Feature request: date range filters on order search. Scrolling back through months is painful.

tickets.subject: Customers can't check out
tickets.body: Two gym-equipment orders failed this morning, both over $1,000. Customers are messaging us asking what's going on.

tickets.subject: Mobile signouts getting worse
tickets.body: The mobile signouts are getting worse — now it's roughly every hour. See my ticket from last week, same thing but more frequent.

tickets.subject: Customers can't give us money
tickets.body: Twice this morning someone rang the shop saying the website wouldn't let them finish. Both were big landscaping quotes. Is there a problem on your side?

tickets.subject: Order form stuck on a spinner
tickets.body: The pay page spinner runs forever on a $1,300 patio set. Cheaper items go through fine. Tried Chrome and Safari, same behaviour.

tickets.subject: Still can't pull weekly numbers
tickets.body: Still can't pull our weekly numbers for the Friday meeting. Same timeout as my earlier ticket. Any progress?

tickets.subject: Follow-up: still broken, losing sales
tickets.body: This is day four of checkout failures. We've lost at least $18k in abandoned carts by our own count. Please escalate — see my earlier ticket.

tickets.subject: Question about VAT on our invoice
tickets.body: Is the VAT rate on our latest invoice correct for Japan? Our finance team flagged it.

tickets.subject: Thanks — great support last month
tickets.body: No issue here — just wanted to say the help we got with our theme last month was excellent.
